biological_finding_justification_present.assessment: The chart does not report any laboratory findings such as WBC, CRP, or synovial cell counts, so presence of qualifying biological findings cannot be established.

c_reactive_protein_value_recorded_now_wi.assessment: No CRP value is reported in the chart.

clinical_finding_justification_present.assessment: Patient has acute joint pain, fever of 38.1°C, joint swelling, and limited range of motion—all qualify as clinical findings per protocol.
clinical_finding_justification_present.evidence: complaining of knee pain for the past 4 days...developed a fever...edema and tenderness of the right thigh and knee, as well as effusion and extremely limited range of motion

imaging_finding_justification_present.assessment: Imaging shows an osteolytic lesion, but this is not strictly one of the required imaging findings (capsular/surrounding soft-tissue swelling, synovial notch, demineralization, periarticular abscess); chart is silent regarding these specific findings.

need_for_synovial_procedure_present.assessment: Although the child has a symptomatic joint with effusion and extremely limited ROM raising suspicion for septic arthritis, the chart does not state that a synovial puncture or biopsy is clinically indicated or planned.

patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years.assessment: The chart explicitly states the patient is a 10-year-old boy.

patient_has_finding_of_abscess_now.assessment: There is no mention of any abscess, periarticular or otherwise.

patient_has_finding_of_abscess_now@@peri.assessment: The chart does not mention a periarticular abscess.

patient_has_finding_of_adenopathy_near_i.assessment: There is no mention of adenopathy near any joint; the chart is silent on this specific finding.

patient_has_finding_of_capsular_and_surr.assessment: Edema and effusion are reported, but the chart does not specifically mention simultaneous capsular and surrounding soft-tissue swelling as distinct or combined entities.

patient_has_finding_of_capsular_swelling.assessment: Edema/effusion is present in the right knee but the chart does not name capsular swelling explicitly.

patient_has_finding_of_demineralization_.assessment: Imaging describes an osteolytic lesion but does not specifically mention demineralization; osteolysis suggests bone destruction but not necessarily generalized demineralization.

patient_has_finding_of_fever_now.assessment: The patient had a fever (noted by guardians and confirmed on exam at 38.1°C).
patient_has_finding_of_fever_now.evidence: The day before the visit the boy developed a fever ... temperature 38.1 C (100.5 F)

patient_has_finding_of_fever_now@@greate.assessment: On exam the patient had a temperature of 38.1°C, meeting the >38°C threshold.

patient_has_finding_of_joint_pain_now.assessment: The patient and guardians report right knee pain present now.
patient_has_finding_of_joint_pain_now.evidence: had been complaining of knee pain for the past 4 days and it had been getting progressively worse

patient_has_finding_of_joint_pain_now@@a.assessment: The joint pain has been present for only 4 days and is worsening, which fits an acute episode.
patient_has_finding_of_joint_pain_now@@a.evidence: knee pain for the past 4 days and it had been getting progressively worse

patient_has_finding_of_joint_swelling_no.assessment: Exam found edema and effusion of the right knee, indicating joint swelling.
patient_has_finding_of_joint_swelling_no.evidence: There was edema and tenderness of the right thigh and knee, as well as effusion

patient_has_need_for_synovial_biopsy_now.assessment: The chart does not document a clinical or procedural need for synovial biopsy; evaluation and imaging led to diagnosis, but the procedural indication is not stated.

patient_has_need_for_synovial_punction_n.assessment: The child presents with acute joint effusion, pain, fever, and extremely limited range of motion; synovial punction is clinically indicated for diagnosis in this context.
patient_has_need_for_synovial_punction_n.evidence: On physical examination ... effusion and extremely limited range of motion.

patient_has_prosthesis_now.assessment: The chart does not mention any implanted prosthetic joint; for a 10-year-old, this would be highly atypical, and silence is informative.
patient_has_prosthesis_now.evidence: silent: prosthesis would be mentioned in pediatric joint pathology

patient_has_prosthesis_now@@at_infected_.assessment: There is no mention of a prosthesis at the affected knee, and it is exceedingly unlikely in a 10-year-old; default is FALSE.
patient_has_prosthesis_now@@at_infected_.evidence: silent: prosthesis at infected knee would be mentioned

patient_has_finding_of_soft_tissue_swell.assessment: Examination describes edema of the thigh and knee, indicating soft tissue swelling.
patient_has_finding_of_soft_tissue_swell.evidence: On physical examination ... edema and tenderness of the right thigh and knee

patient_has_suspicion_of_acute_suppurati.assessment: The clinical vignette describes acute monoarthritis, fever, effusion, and lethargy; these strongly support suspected septic (suppurative) arthritis.
patient_has_suspicion_of_acute_suppurati.evidence: The child ... complaining of knee pain for the past 4 days ... developed a fever ... effusion and extremely limited range of motion.

patient_has_finding_of_synovial_notch_no.assessment: There is no mention in imaging or exam of a synovial notch; default to NULL as chart is silent.

patient_is_eligible_for_inclusion_septic.assessment: The patient has acute joint pain/swelling, fever >38°C, limited range of motion, and no prosthesis; he meets clinical criteria for suspected native joint septic arthritis.
patient_is_eligible_for_inclusion_septic.evidence: effusion and extremely limited range of motion ... temperature 38.1 C ... edema and tenderness of the right thigh and knee

justification_present.assessment: The patient has multiple qualifying findings: fever >38°C, soft tissue swelling, effusion, limited range of motion, and imaging shows an osteolytic lesion.
justification_present.evidence: temperature 38.1 C ... edema and tenderness ... effusion and extremely limited range of motion ... osteolytic lesion

synovial_leukocyte_count_value_recorded_.assessment: The chart provides no synovial leukocyte count; default to NULL.

__THRESH__::synovial_leukocyte_count_val.assessment: There is no documented synovial leukocyte count, so it cannot be determined if threshold >2000 is met; default to NULL.

synovial_polymorphonuclear_leukocyte_cou.assessment: The chart does not mention any synovial fluid analysis or provide a value for polymorphonuclear leukocyte percentage.

white_blood_cell_count_value_recorded_no.assessment: No peripheral white blood cell count is described in the vignette.
